author: Creator Toolset
name: Analyzer basics
description: The team's default for the Content Analyzer: ideas named by what the viewer gets, in words a viewer would search for.

instructions.analyzer.ideas: Name each idea by what the viewer gets out of it, in plain words they would type into a search box, not by the format of the post. Keep the creator's own claim as the takeaway; don't add facts the post doesn't make.
